references.title: On pressure and velocity flow boundary conditions and bounceback for the lattice Boltzmann BGK model
references.actually_read: Extracted pp2-7, equations1-3,17-29 and nearby discussion. Standard versus incompressible equilibrium, moment reconstruction for flat density/velocity boundaries, corner qualification and fixed-Mach compressibility caveat.
references.role: Adopted standard D2Q9 equilibrium and independently indexed left/right Zou-He moment closure.
references.not_claimed: No use of the paper's special incompressible d2q9i machine-accuracy results as a pass for standard compressible BGK. No full-paper/rendered-symbol audit.

references.title: Lattice Boltzmann method for moving boundaries
references.actually_read: Original article extracted text sec3, printed410-414, Fig2 discussion and equations12-15. Off-grid bounce-back paths, before/after-stream interpolation, q=.5 reduction, moving-wall correction, momentum exchange and explicit warning that interpolation compromises mass conservation.
references.role: Primary derivation context. Our two-point linear formula is independently derived and qualified, while the displayed primary formulas are quadratic. Coordinate orientation and moving-wall signs are independently checked.
references.not_claimed: No original C++/author code copied, no moving-particle geometry/topology implementation, no general Galilean-invariance certification.

references.title: Benchmark Computations of Laminar Flow Around a Cylinder
references.official_attempt_results: Both returned404 through the web tool; original20-page article text was read from the course mirror.
references.actually_read: Printed pp3-4 geometry/properties/2D-1 definitions and Fig1; p7 protocol statement on user-chosen outflow; pp11-12 description of estimated intervals and Table3. Requested rendered snapshots for pp3/12 but do not claim a separate local rendered-symbol audit.
references.qualification_boundary: Original authors' estimated comparison ranges, not rigorous exact-error enclosures. The original explicitly permits selecting an outflow condition. This release declares its finite-grid Zou-He outlet and does not equate it to FEATflow's later do-nothing outlet.

references.title: DFG flow around cylinder benchmark2D-1
references.actually_read: Geometry, inlet/outlet conditions, mean-speed normalization, force and pressure-probe definitions and reference-result attribution. The page attributes precise values to Nabh1998 spectral calculations.
references.not_claimed: Nabh1998 original full report was not read. Its do-nothing outlet is not the adopted lattice boundary condition; these precise numbers are secondary context, not falsely labelled exact same-BC kinetic truth.
